coexistence_inventory.description: Protected parallel workflow for older customers (FR-CO-02, OPD-15). Exposed read-only; the product cannot alter, disable or retire it.

deviations.justification: SQL report 1 total inflated by LEFT JOIN events fan-out (BB-08); new month_end_total sums cases once. F10-2 DV-01 (fix).
Legacy marks every REPLAY as DUPLICATE (BB-05); new distinguishes identical vs changed content. F10-2 DV-02 (fix).
Legacy rejects negative quantity; new keeps it flagged for review. F10-2 DV-03 (change of class).
Legacy Java silently skips blank amounts; new reports UNPARSABLE_AMOUNT (quarantine). F10-2 DV-04 (fix).
Legacy JS tolerance with 'abc'/null is undefined behaviour; new rejects invalid input. F10-2 DV-05 (fix).
Unknown region/year default 999999 kept but marked defaulted. F10-2 DV-06 (additive).
Legacy reconcile overwrites processing_status in place; new appends outcomes and leaves the legacy table untouched. F10-2 DV-07 (fix).
Night-shift join multiplies rows (118 distinct objects in first 500); new evaluates per entity (500 distinct in first 500). F10-2 DV-08 (fix).
Legacy counts invalid gateway events but does not store them; new stores them in quarantine. F10-2 DV-09 (fix).

note: INC-02 seed. Every deviation ships status 'proposed' (F10-2; OD-S12-13 open; HAR-06). legacy_value/new_value are canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact). Synthetic, unvalidated.
